user.title: Peblar EV Charger
user.description: Enter the IP address and API key of your Peblar charger. The API key can be found in the Peblar app under Settings > API.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of your Peblar charger (e.g. 192.168.1.100)
data_description.api_key: API key for authenticating with the charger's local REST API

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Peblar charger. Check the IP address and ensure the charger is online.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Check the key in the Peblar app.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.already_configured: A Peblar charger with this serial number is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This Peblar charger is already configured.
